hero_headline: East Haven plumbing, heating & remodels, done once
hero_sub: A licensed master plumber with 27 years on the tools, now running his own company. Free estimates across the Shoreline and Greater New Haven.
about:
Skull and Homes Company is Richard Esposito and Jason Bunce, based right here in East Haven. Richard has held a Connecticut P-1 unlimited plumbing contractor license since 1999 and a heating, piping & cooling license since 1996, so the person quoting your job is the person who knows how to do it.
We take on the work homeowners actually need: leaks and repairs, water heaters, heating systems, and kitchen and bath remodels where the plumbing has to be right before the tile goes down.

services.name: Plumbing repairs
services.description: Leaks, clogs, running toilets, low pressure, burst pipes. Diagnosed and fixed by a licensed P-1 contractor.

services.name: Water heaters

services.name: Heating & boilers
services.description: Boiler and hydronic heating repair, replacement and seasonal service before the cold hits.

services.name: Kitchen & bath remodels
services.description: Full remodels with the plumbing done properly behind the walls, from rough-in to final fixtures.

services.name: Fixture installs
services.description: Sinks, faucets, toilets, showers, disposals and dishwashers, installed clean and leak-free.

services.name: Gas piping
services.description: Gas lines for ranges, dryers, heaters and generators, installed to code.

founder_brief: No web footprint yet for the LLC or either owner (searched business name and principal + trade + town). The strong verified hook is the state license: Richard Esposito, P-1 unlimited plumbing contractor since 1999 and heating license since 1996, East Haven. That's a 27-year tradesman going out on his own, so lead with 'you've done this for 27 years, now it's your name on the truck'. Co-owner Jason Bunce holds an active hairdresser license (2015), probably a family/partner co-founder rather than a trade partner; don't feature him in the pitch. Name is a pun ('Skull and Bones' → Skull and Homes), so they like personality and the site can lean into it once claimed.
